purpose: Approved repository-intelligence tools and local fallbacks for every Solo Suite platform.

policy.installation: Explicit opt-in only; never install from lifecycle hooks or overwrite global agent configuration.
policy.secrets: Never commit API keys or client configuration containing secrets.
policy.activation: Use Graphify only for relationship questions and Repomix only for bounded exports.

tools.name: Graphify
tools.scope: .tools/graphify/venv when no audited PATH installation is available

projectIntegrations.claude: Use the generated repository skill mirror; do not install Graphify hooks.
projectIntegrations.codex: Use AGENTS.md and the canonical repository routing skill.
projectIntegrations.antigravity: Use .agents skills and rules; do not run a platform installer automatically.

tools.name: Repomix
tools.responsibility: Filtered repository snapshots, compression, and handoffs
tools.install: No automatic install; approve and pin separately before use.

fallbacks.symbols: Graphify query/explain/path, then bounded rg search and client-native workspace editing.
fallbacks.currentDocumentation: Primary official documentation through reviewed host web access.
fallbacks.codingClient: The active Codex, Claude, or Antigravity client.
